question: Does frozen PERF-S1 F2 Source-Aligned Header materially improve attribution of the dominant Performance to Marlowe in the exact PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 Stage while keeping Performance a shared Stage occurrence and preserving every other Stage variable?
single_variable: horizontal source attribution of the existing dominant Performance source header

frozen_translation.translation_law: Move only the existing complete MARLOWE source-header raster horizontally by +177 px. Do not render replacement text, move the panel or alter quote/history geometry.

glyph_mask_law.completeness_rule: The complete source-header raster envelope is every pixel in the frozen 80x12 bbox, independent of color, brightness or neighborhood membership.
glyph_mask_law.source_pixel_preservation: Destination copies the exact incumbent RGB value at every one of the 960 source-envelope coordinates; no font rendering, recoloring, resampling or alpha synthesis is allowed.

source_erasure_law.replacement_rule: For every source-envelope pixel (x,y) in x=65..144 and y=580..591 inclusive, replace that pixel with the per-channel median of incumbent pixels at the same x over rows y=574..578 and y=593..597 inclusive, rounded to nearest uint8 exactly as prior methods.

destination_compositing_law.write_order: Reconstruct the full 960-pixel source bbox, then copy every original source-envelope RGB value to (x+177,y).
destination_compositing_law.collision_rule: Any translated coordinate outside target bbox [242,580,321,591] fails construction before scoring.
destination_compositing_law.destination_patch_integrity_rule: The exact translated 80x12 raster must not produce a visually legible rectangular patch seam against the fixed Performance panel; any seam is a technical failure before scoring.

pixel_preservation_law.only_permitted_changed_coordinates: the 960 source-envelope coordinates and their +177 px translated destination coordinates
must_be_exact: all pixels outside those source/destination rectangles
Performance panel frame/background outside the two 80x12 rectangles
Recent Beats label and all four history rows
pixel_preservation_law.semantic_law: Only explicit source-header attribution is tested; the full-bbox transfer is a construction-completeness mechanism, not a new visual treatment.

required: source envelope contains exactly 960 pixels covering the exact frozen 80x12 bbox
all changed pixels are a subset of source-envelope union translated-destination rectangle coordinates
dominant quote and Recent Beats rows are pixel-identical
shell, Production/Scene, right rail, controls and footer are pixel-identical
target header center remains within 1 px of Marlowe source anchor x=282
no visibly legible source-header ghost remains before subjective scoring
no visually legible rectangular destination patch seam exists before subjective scoring
challenger and comparison board receive immutable hashes and Drive readback verification before scoring
construction_preflight.technical_failure_law: A construction, preservation, ghost or destination-seam defect rejects the attempt before scoring. Translation, source anchor, F2 mechanism and evaluation law may not change.

evaluation_criteria: F2 must make Marlowe attribution immediately clearer than the incumbent detached left-aligned header.
The dominant Performance must still read as one shared Stage occurrence rather than Marlowe's private card, chat bubble or direct-message surface.
The fixed panel must remain compositionally stable; source attribution may move inside it without making the panel itself appear to move toward Marlowe.
The aligned header must not compete with or visually fuse into Marlowe's cone/name/state carrier.
The quote and Recent Beats hierarchy must remain materially unchanged and readable as dominant current Performance plus secondary recent history.
The relocation must not imply Current Opportunity, selection, causal direction, Observation/Knowledge/Memory or durable consequence.
The change must not increase competition with Production/Scene context, creator controls or the right rail.
The relocated header must remain visually balanced inside the real Stage panel and must not create a conspicuous empty-left / heavy-middle artifact.
Promotion requires a material net improvement over PKT-STAGE-CORE-02; parity or mixed tradeoff retains the incumbent.

decision_law.failure_consequence: Retain PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 and close the F2 comparison without F2b, alternative translation, panel motion or replacement attribution family in this gate.
decision_law.promotion_consequence: Promote only the bounded Performance source-header attribution successor. No Beat/history-density, Archive, motion, palette, runtime-semantic, implementation or ODR authority is created.

next_action: Commit and hosted-validate Method 04. Only then construct one F2 challenger from exact incumbent bytes using the complete 80x12 raster envelope, prove source/destination isolation and protected-region identity, perform mandatory ghost and destination-seam integrity checks, hash and Drive-readback artifacts, then score the unchanged nine criteria only if all technical checks pass.
method_03_change_scope: Only deterministic inclusion of adjacent dark glyph/shadow raster changes after TECH-02. F2 geometry, +177 px translation, source anchor, fixed panel, nine evaluation criteria and decision law are unchanged.
method_04_change_scope: Only deterministic source-header raster completeness/erasure changes after TECH-03: full 80x12 source envelope transfer. F2 geometry, +177 px translation, x=282 source anchor, fixed panel, all nine evaluation criteria and decision law are unchanged.
